verdict.rationale: Synctera is a banking-as-a-service API platform with SDKs, a dashboard, and docs, so telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers only customers, accounts, cards, payments, KYC, webhooks, llms.txt and the OpenAPI spec. Nothing mentions telemetry controls, analytics opt-out, or usage-tracking settings.
